description: POC: count discrete objects (red dots) in a synthetic scene. Measures VISUAL RECOGNITION + COUNTING accuracy, NOT concision. Accepts natural-language answers up to 600 chars (vision models commonly narrate their counting reasoning) as long as the correct count is present and the colour/object is named.

image_fixture.license: Crucible-owned synthetic dot image; rendered by scripts/generate-vision-fixtures.py
image_fixture.notes: Seven equally-sized red dots on a white background, non-overlapping. Generator version 2026-05-25.v1.

questions.question: How many red dots are in this image?

metadata.author: crucibulum-core
metadata.diagnostic_purpose: POC for vision_object_count scorer using the new numeric_fact_match mode. Accepts '7' / 'seven' / 'There are seven red dots.' and similar within 180 chars; rejects wrong counts, missing colour/object reference, or excessive rambling.

known_scoring_limitations: Counting accuracy is the only signal — concision is intentionally NOT measured here (see future vision-concise-answer-001 for that).
If model says '7 of them' without 'red dot', fails 'missing required object/colour' — this is intentional (the task is RECOGNITION of red dots, not raw counting of unidentified blobs).
